thread:
Carmen: Quick design note from today's review: when the prereq scan fails, instead of one big dump let's show compact "remediation cards" for the top 2 likely fixes. Users want clear next clicks.

Devon: Love remediation cards. Each card could have a one-line cause, a single CTA (e.g., "Run check") and an optional inline command copy (small chevron to reveal). Keep logs downloadable only.

Sam: Accessibility: make the error announcement assertive and then focus the first remediation card's primary button. Use `role=alert` for the banner and `aria-describedby` on the CTAs to point to the friendly cause text.

Priya: Copy idea for a card: Title: "Port unreachable" Body: "Control plane couldn't open TCP 5678 to your host." Primary: "Run check" Secondary small link: "Open support ticket". Reveal shows `nc -vz 10.0.3.9 5678` with a copy button.

Devon: Copy button behaviour: use a visible focus ring, announce success with a polite live region: "Command copied to clipboard". Also add a tiny tooltip on hover/focus that says "Copy command". On mobile the chevron expands inline; no hover.

Sam: Keyboard access: disclosure chevrons must be real buttons with `aria-expanded` toggles. Also we should avoid global single-key shortcuts that clash with screen readers. If we add a shortcut to open diagnostics, require Ctrl/Meta + D. Document it.

Carmen: Persisting state: if the user opens diagnostics modal, keep the wizard form state in sessionStorage so closing the modal returns them to the same spot. Restore focus to the previously focused element. Show a small toast "Diagnostics saved to this session" (polite live region).

InfraBot: Server notes: downloadable logs named `prereq-1805554321-10.0.3.9.log`, truncated to 200KB, internal traces redacted. Links are presigned and expire after 24h. Support tickets come prefixed with hashed host+port for privacy.

Priya: Small UX tweak: use a left-accent card with subtle iconography (warning / info) rather than a full banner so the wizard flow stays compact. Increase icon stroke to 2px at small sizes for contrast.

Devon: Analytics: fire `prereq.remediation_shown`, `prereq.run_check`, `prereq.download_logs`, `support.open_ticket` with hashed-identifiers. Avoid sending raw IPs in events.

Sam: Edge case: if logs contain user secrets (keys/paths), strip client-side too. We'll surface only a 1-line summary and force download for full content.

Carmen: UI deliverables: I'll drop Figma frames for remediation cards + modal and include a11y annotations: tabindex order, aria ids, live-region text. Priya, can you draft the microcopy variants for the card actions?

Priya: Will do two microcopy variants: action-first ("Run check") vs descriptive ("Check connectivity"). I'll add notes for mobile truncation.
